## File: facebookresearch_fairchem/src/fairchem/applications/fastcsp/core/cli.py

Prompts

```
['run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config file and selected stages', 'run the generate stage to create crystal structures using Genarris via the FastCSP CLI', 'run the relax stage to perform UMA-based structure relaxations in the FastCSP workflow', 'run the filter stage to filter and remove duplicates for ranking in FastCSP', 'run the evaluate stage to compare predicted structures against experimental structures in FastCSP']
```

Usage

```
{'run_fastcsp_workflow': 'run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config file and selected stages', 'run_fastcsp_generate': 'run the generate stage to create crystal structures using Genarris via the FastCSP CLI', 'run_fastcsp_relax': 'run the relax stage to perform UMA-based structure relaxations in the FastCSP workflow', 'run_fastcsp_filter': 'run the filter stage to filter and remove duplicates for ranking in FastCSP', 'run_fastcsp_evaluate': 'run the evaluate stage to compare predicted structures against experimental structures in FastCSP'}
```
